title: A Drone Battery Swap in 25 Seconds
description: DJI launched Dock 4, a drone-in-a-box dock that swaps the battery automatically in about twenty-five seconds, against roughly ninety seconds to two minutes for other docks. It launched with the Matrice 5TD enterprise drone; pricing is not announced and it is unlikely to be sold in the United States.
series: This Week in Drones and AI

beats.vo: Twenty five seconds. That's how fast this drone gets fresh batteries.

beats.text: DJI Dock 4 swaps the battery, then relaunches
beats.vo: DJI says its new Dock Four swaps the battery by itself, so the drone relaunches in about twenty five seconds. Other docks need ninety seconds to two minutes. But here's the catch: no price yet, and it likely won't be sold in the U S.
Know someone who thinks drones always sit idle, charging? Send them this. Waiting time is an engineering problem.

caption:
A drone battery swap in 25 seconds. That's DJI Dock 4. 🚁
The drone-in-a-box dock changes batteries by itself; other docks typically need 90 seconds to 2 minutes. It launched with the Matrice 5TD, rated up to 59 minutes of flight in DJI's tests.
The catch: no price announced, and it's unlikely to be sold in the US.
